title: 3D Interactive Aquarium
physics_constraints: fish motion: sine-wave composite for x/y/z
stork dive: parabolic arc, 1.5s each way
difficulty_analysis: L4: Loading and cloning multiple models with GLTFLoader, independent sine-wave swimming paths and orientation calculations for 8 fish, a click-triggered parabolic diving animation for the stork, fish capture and respawn logic, a semi-transparent water-surface effect, and state-machine management.
